The '''Municipal Utility District''' was a utility district in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris's]] planet-city before the [[destruction of Taris]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. In the aftermath of the planet's bombardment, the Municipal Utility District collapsed. During the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]], it became part of the area known as the [[Republic Resettlement Zone]]. During this time it was infested with [[rakghoul]]s.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Municipal Utility District appears on Taris in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
